mission: Build a fractal Google Maps of law for Swiss Federal Supreme Court case law from 2000 onward plus user-imported corpora, beating simple semantic-map baselines in legal usefulness.

corpus.question: Scale the canonical TF-2000+ acquisition/normalization pipeline from current 1,577 decisions (1000 slice + 250 yearly core 2020-2024) to full coverage (2000-2024, ~192k decisions) via OpenCaseLaw bulk ingestion. Build citation ID resolution pipeline (BGE/ATF → corpus decision_id) to unlock citation role modeling integration (2,988 annotations blocked). Implement robust user corpus import with schema validation and map artifact persistence.

legal-distance.question: (1) Test multilingual-e5-small fine-tuning on Swiss legal corpus for multilingual invariance WITH coarse legal structure (GPU required; code ready from v6); (2) Citation role modeling: integrate 2,988 role annotations once citation ID resolution pipeline ready (corpus lane dependency); (3) Execute jurist pairwise evaluation of hybrid map modes vs center_projected baseline (framework ready, needs 5-10 Swiss jurists); (4) Benchmark refinement: maintain refined 16-benchmark suite with adversarial gates as primary. VALIDATED BASELINES (frozen harness v3 seed=42): center_projected_64dim (JP=0.512, LangDom=0.766), linear_metric_epoch4 (JP=0.6847, LangDom=0.673), mahalanobis_metric_epoch4 (JP=0.6781, LangDom=0.678), hybrid_stabilized_epoch1 (JP=0.6656, LangDom=0.660), cited_decisions_tfidf (JP=0.6889, LangDom=0.6086 — ZERO-SHOT, BEATS supervised metric learning on jurist pairwise), cited_decisions_tfidf_hybrid_cp64_0.7 (JP=0.6614, LangDom=0.6542 — BEST production hybrid, uses 64-dim frozen PCA). BOILERPLATE RESISTANCE CORRECTION: Real test (evaluation_v3_boilerplate_real_20260829, REPRODUCED) shows 89-93% neighbor preservation when boilerplate removed — boilerplate NOT driving neighbors. v3 'boilerplate resistance' proxy MISNAMED; measured language dominance (cross-lingual alignment failure). Systemic challenge is language dominance / cross-lingual alignment, not boilerplate.

fractal-map.question: EXTEND validated hierarchical Leiden map (nesting=1.0, purity=0.9638, zoom_coherence 63% improvement rate) to new validated representations: (a) linear_metric_epoch4, (b) mahalanobis_metric_epoch4, (c) cited_decisions_tfidf, (d) best cited_decisions_tfidf hybrids (cp64_0.7, cp768_0.3, etc.) as selectable map modes. Expose resolution ladder, cluster metadata, legal coherence at each zoom level in product; integrate as default map structure with legal-distance selectable modes. center_projected_hierarchical REPRODUCED as DEFAULT (nesting=1.0, purity=0.9638, 7-res ladder, 108 clusters).

evaluation.question: Next cycle (v7) on expanded/full corpus using adversarial benchmarks: (1) Full corpus scale evaluation (192k decisions) — validate metric learning representations at production scale, test scale stability on full corpus, evaluate fractal map quality at production scale; (2) Citation role modeling evaluation — once citation ID resolution pipeline ready, evaluate 2,988 role annotations (overruling, distinguishing, following) against adversarial gates; (3) Legal embeddings fine-tuning evaluation — test multilingual-e5-small fine-tuned on Swiss legal corpus, evaluate multilingual invariance with coarse legal structure, compare against center_projected_64dim baseline; (4) Jurist human study (framework ready) — execute pairwise preference study with 5-10 Swiss jurists, validate simulated jurist proxy against real jurist judgments, test map mode preferences (legal issue vs reasoning vs citation views); (5) Boilerplate resistance deeper investigation — develop better boilerplate removal (section-aware), test if metric learning representations improve boilerplate resistance, evaluate section-specific embeddings (sachverhalt, erwaegungen, dispositiv); (6) User corpus import evaluation — validate map artifacts persist correctly for user-imported corpora, test recomputation triggers and incremental updates, evaluate schema validation robustness. v6 COMPLETED: frozen harness v3 (seed=42, config_hash=4323f833fa72366a) fully reproducible; center_projected_64dim ONLY unsupervised baseline passing both adversarial gates; metric learning breakthrough confirmed; cited_decisions_tfidf zero-shot breakthrough confirmed; all 6 hybrids PASS both gates; boilerplate resistance correction confirmed.

product.question: Vertical slice COMPLETE with center_projected_64dim_hierarchical as DEFAULT (97/97 tests, 12 representations). Next phase: Continuous improvement — harden TF base map for production at 192k scale, optimize map rendering performance, implement map mode comparison UI (center_projected vs metric learning vs cited_decisions_tfidf vs hybrids), add jurist feedback capture endpoints, prepare for full corpus map persistence. User corpus import and map export operational. center_projected_64dim_hierarchical is DEFAULT map mode (nesting=1.0, purity=0.9718, 108 fine clusters in 7 coarse, both adversarial gates PASS). Add metric learning representations (linear_metric, mahalanobis, hybrid_stabilized) and cited_decisions_tfidf + hybrids as selectable map modes with clear labeling (e.g., 'Cross-Lingual Legal', 'Doctrinal Lineage', 'Precedent/Citation').
